raw_text: THREAD: New satellite imagery from Feb 10 shows Eritrean military vehicles still positioned near Axum, Tigray despite the November ceasefire agreement. At least 12 armored vehicles visible at coordinates near the main road. Ceasefire violations continue to be documented by independent monitors. The international community remains largely silent on these developments.
